description: This PHP source file defines the AOS_QuotesDashlet class, which extends DashletGeneric, and is used for displaying a customizable dashboard widget (dashlet) related to quotes in SuiteCRM. It initializes dashlet data, loads metadata, and sets up the widget's title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGeneric to render a quotes dashlet widget on the SuiteCRM dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: The constructor initializes the dashlet by loading metadata, setting its title, and configuring search fields, columns, and the seed bean for quote records.
